common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

notable.title: Hot Conflict Between Major Powers
notable.line: The US and China are shooting at each other.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Grid sabotage sites
notable.line: Coordinated physical attacks on transmission lines feeding the two guarded gigafactory sites and nearby substations cause prolonged outages, forcing contractors to suspend works and insurers to withdraw cover.

notable.title: Robot fleet killswitch
notable.line: Chinese humanoid suppliers push a managed fleet-update that briefly bricks logistics robots in several EU plants, exposing remote kill-switch dependence and forcing emergency maintenance talks.

notable.title: Siting blockade wave
notable.line: Coordinated municipal blockades of grid-priority gigafactory construction sites spread across two member states, fusing anti-data-centre, water-use and jobs grievances into a physical siting veto.
